The document intake of the photographs and the bills, rwb-document (P5), /api/recovery/document/v1, operation name placeholder

workflows: InstructionWorkflow on queue rwb-partner in namespace rwb-recovery, one execution per partner instruction, carrying the field-work step behind the resultSubmitted signal
recordFieldWorkResult activity on queue rwb-partner, the one field-work step: the record, the instruction row, the outbox row and the key in one transaction
the stage outcome on the parent-child edge to CaseWorkflow on queue rwb-case; the case stage and its clock are P3's; no Schedule and no job
